EmailTemplate.subject: Are you going to the Cerner Health Forum? We’ll see you there!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
With most patients still stuck at home and the majority of in-person health services shifted online, providing an easy-to-use, consumer-friendly, digital experience is more important than ever.
Visit us this week at the Cerner Health Forum, where we can share why Flywire was chosen as Cerner’s preferred partner for patient engagement and how we can help you create the financial experience your patients desire.
Visit our booth <[[https://chf21.hubb.me/fe/schedule-builder/sponsors/43408?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Can’t make the health forum? Check out our Cerner page <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/healthcare/our-cerner-partnership?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>to learn more about the Flywire and Cerner partnership.
Warm regards,
